As a manufacturer-independent specialist, scopeREPAIR offers professional repair, maintenance, and distribution of flexible medical endoscopes. As a manufacturer-independent specialist, we repair and service flexible endoscopes from the leading brands Olympus, Pentax, and Fujinon. Our medical technology service covers all common endoscope types, including gastroscopes, colonoscopes, bronchoscopes, cystoscopes, and duodenoscopes.
Why does professional endoscope repair without a maintenance contract pay off?

Our philosophy is simple: necessary repairs instead of unnecessary fixed costs. Professional repair by our experienced technicians extends the lifespan of your medical equipment, reduces investment costs, and offers an economical alternative to long-term maintenance contracts. We only ever replace components that are actually defective.
Does scopeREPAIR also offer used endoscopes?

Our range includes professionally inspected, refurbished endoscopes as well as complete endoscopy systems from renowned manufacturers. For added investment security, you receive a 12-month warranty when purchasing a used endoscope.
Are original spare parts used for endoscope repairs?
For every endoscope repair, scopeREPAIR uses only high-quality spare parts. This ensures reliable function, high safety standards, and long-term use of your medical equipment.
How does scopeREPAIR's repair service work?

The process is simple and transparent: you can commission us via the pickup order form, or contact us directly for personal consultation. After a technical analysis, you'll receive a detailed cost estimate. Your endoscope is only repaired once you've given your approval.
Does scopeREPAIR provide loaner devices during repair?
Yes. To keep downtime and disruption in your practice or hospital to a minimum, we provide a suitable replacement device from our loaner service during the repair, subject to availability.

en: Which endoscopes does scopeREPAIR repair?

We repair flexible endoscopes from all common manufacturers. We specialize particularly in devices from Olympus, Pentax, Fujinon, and Storz. We also carry out repairs on endoscopes from other manufacturers.
How does an endoscope repair work?

After you report the damage, we can arrange to pick up your endoscope on request. A careful damage analysis follows, including a leak test of the device. You'll receive a transparent cost estimate. The repair is carried out to strict quality standards using validated testing procedures, followed by a final safety and function check before the device is shipped back.
How long does an endoscope repair take?

Repair time depends on the extent of the damage and the availability of the required spare parts. Once you give your approval, our technicians begin the repair as quickly as possible. Our goal is to keep the downtime of your endoscopes to a minimum.
Does scopeREPAIR offer a pickup service?
Yes. We arrange the pickup of your defective endoscope, so you don't need to handle the shipping yourself. Once the repair is complete, we reliably send your device back to you.
Can I get a loaner device during the repair?
Yes. To minimize downtime in your clinic or practice, we provide compatible loaner endoscopes during the repair. Availability depends on the specific model.
What warranty do I get on the repair?
You receive a 6-month warranty on all endoscope repairs we carry out. This covers the defects fixed as part of the repair.
Are high-quality spare parts used?
We use only high-quality spare parts. This ensures high reliability, safety, and durability of the repaired endoscopes.
Does scopeREPAIR repair devices independent of manufacturer?
Yes. Our repairs are manufacturer-independent. Thanks to years of experience, we professionally repair endoscopes from a wide range of manufacturers, including Olympus, Pentax, Fujinon, and Storz.
Do I need to sign a maintenance contract?
No. A maintenance contract is not required for a repair. We only repair the components that are actually necessary — transparently, economically, and without hidden costs.
Do I receive documentation of the repair?
Yes. After the repair is complete, every endoscope undergoes a thorough final inspection. The test results are documented and handed over together with the device.
What happens if a repair is no longer worthwhile?
If a repair is not economically worthwhile, we'll advise you transparently on possible alternatives. On request, we can also offer you refurbished endoscopes with a 12-month warranty.
Why is an endoscope repair more economical than buying new?

A professional repair significantly extends the lifespan of your medical equipment and reduces investment costs. Repairing to current value offers clinics and practices an economical alternative while maintaining consistently high quality and safety.
